body:
## Lost Trinkets Renewed
Lost Trinkets adds in 70+ exceedingly rare unlockable trinkets with different useful abilities for you to play with. Trinkets completely change the way you play the game by giving you over-powered skills.
**How to unlock trinkets:** Trinkets are randomly unlocked when doing activities like fighting enemies and bosses, trading, mining ores, cutting trees, and farming. Each activity has their own chance of giving you a trinket, some riskier activities may reward you sooner with goods. (Check the config file to tweak the different unlock chances to your liking) **How to check enable/check your trinkets:** By default, you can access the trinket GUI by pressing the "R" key on your keyboard.
## ✨ Features - **Lots of Trinkets** - Discover, Unlock, and Try a bunch of trinkets that'll spice up your gameplay! - **Custom Builds** - Mix and create different builds that completely change your gameplay! - **Get STRONG** - Get even more OP with each Trinket, slay your enemies with ease!
## 📷 Media
## 📥 Installation **Client & Server Required !** **Forge/Neoforge requires:** - [Architectury API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/architectury-api) **Fabric requires:** - [Architectury API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/architectury-api) - [Forge Config API Port](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/forge-config-api-port) - [Fabric API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api)
## ⚙️ Configuration Most options can be changed through editting the config file in `.minecraft/config/losttrinkets-common.toml` directly, you should be able to tweak the mod to your liking there, as well as change the rate in which trinkets are unlocked. > **Tip:** edits made to the config file apply the next time you load a world.
## ❤️ Credits Ported & Maintained with care by **Antikythera Studios**. This is the 1.20+ port of Lost Trinkets, originally made by owmii for Forge 1.16.1-1.16.5. The license is LGPL and owmii has been MIA since 2021, so I decided to pick up the mod. Available on Forge/Neoforge and Fabric in 1.20+. Enjoying the mod? A ⭐ on the repo recommending the mod on Modrinth / CurseForge helps more than you'd think.
